title: Space intelligences chose Owens for the strongest nervous system since Moses

tellings.quote: He would claim that they discovered he had the most powerful nervous system of anybody they had ever encountered since Moses.

plain: A man named Ted Owens, who claimed contact with beings he called space intelligences, said they chose him because he had "the most powerful nervous system of anybody they had ever encountered since Moses." The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove, who knew Owens's claims, repeats them to Michels. In Owens's telling, that made him a uniquely fit channel for these beings.
